heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Is Node.js good for real-time apps?
items.answer: Yes. Its event-driven design is well suited to chat, tracking and live updates.

items.question: Can Node.js replace my current backend?
items.answer: Often yes. We assess your system and migrate in stages if it makes sense.

items.question: Do you use TypeScript?
items.answer: Yes. We commonly use TypeScript for safer, easier-to-maintain code.

items.question: How long does nodejs development take?
items.answer: A business website usually takes 4 to 8 weeks, while custom web applications take 3 to 6 months depending on features and integrations.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
